header.title: GradientGlossy
header.description: Glossy zenith lighting on any base color: a three-stop gradient (light, base, and base mixed with black) plus a white `inset` sheen on the lit edge. It's painted as the element's own background, so it works on a `div` or, with `asChild`, on a gem-system button. `variant` sets the strength (`soft`, `lit`, `deep`) and `direction` where the light falls.

playground.title: Playground
playground.description: Combine the props and see the code they generate.
playground.label: Glossy

base.title: Basic gloss
base.description: With the defaults (`variant="lit"`, `direction="to-bottom"`, `intensity="md"`), `primary-500` is lit from above: `28%` white at the top, the pure color at `48%`, and `32%` black at the bottom. The radius goes on the root, because the gloss is its own background.

variants.title: Variants
variants.description: `soft` mixes less white and black, `lit` is the classic three-stop gloss, and `deep` darkens the bottom much more.

direction.title: Direction
direction.description: `direction` aims the light → base → dark axis. The `1px` inset sheen moves with it and always stays on the lit side.

card.title: On a card
card.description: The gloss covers any surface. Here with `variant="soft"` and `color` set to `secondary-500`, so the card gets volume without hurting the text.

texts.title: Surfaces with volume
texts.body: A three-stop gradient and an edge sheen, on any color.

colors.title: Colors
colors.description: `color` takes any CSS color: tokens, hex, or names. The light and dark stops are computed with `color-mix`, so the same gloss works on any base. Prefer tokens.

tuning.title: Lift, depth, sheen, and mid
tuning.description: `lift` is how much white mixes in at the top, `depth` how much black at the bottom, and `sheen` the opacity of the edge sheen, all as percentages (`0` to `90`). When omitted, the CSS computes them from `variant` and `intensity`. `mid` moves the base color stop along the axis.

triggers.title: Triggers
triggers.description: With `hover` the gloss is off (transparent background) and fades in when the pointer enters or something inside gets keyboard focus. With `click`, each click turns it on or off.

intensity.title: Intensity
intensity.description: `intensity` raises or lowers the contrast of the three stops and the sheen. It takes `sm`, `md`, `lg`, or a number from `0` to `1`. It's resolved in CSS from `--gemfx-gradient-glossy-intensity`: each variant starts from its `md` values and scales them proportionally, so you can also change it (or the `--gemfx-intensity-*` tokens) from a class.

duration.title: Duration
duration.description: `duration` is the fade when turning on and off, in milliseconds. What transitions is `--gemfx-gradient-glossy-amount` (a number registered with `@property`), so the background color, the three stops, and the sheen fade together. `delay` postpones it. Hover each box.

asChild.title: On a button (asChild)
asChild.description: With `asChild`, the gloss is applied straight onto gem-system's `Button`, without an extra `div`. The button keeps its text color and its transitions, and the gradient shows whatever the CSS load order. It covers the variant's color, so pass `color` with the tone you want.

state.title: Active, paused, and disabled
state.description: `isActive={false}` and `isDisabled` turn the gloss off (with the same fade) and keep the content interactive; `isDisabled` also removes `cursor: pointer`. `isPaused` freezes the fade at its current value: turn it on halfway and the gloss stays partial, and state changes don't show until you turn it off; then the fade continues from that value toward the new state. Here the fade takes `1200ms` so it's noticeable.

callbacks.title: Events
callbacks.description: `onGradientGlossy` fires when the gloss turns on (pointer enter or keyboard focus with `hover`, click with `click`, or mount with `always`) and `outGradientGlossy` when it turns off, with the reason in `event.reason`. The button still gets clicks.

texts.body: Hover the card (or Tab to the button) to turn the gloss on and click the button.

header.title: GradientGlossy API
header.description: Reference for the props, inheritance, accessibility, CSS classes and variables, and exported types of `GradientGlossy`.

demos.title: Demos
demos.description: Playground and examples for every variant, direction, trigger, and option.

import.title: Import
import.description: Import it from `@gem-org/gemffects/gradient-glossy` with its `gradient-glossy.css`, or from the root if you already load `styles.css`.

inheritance.title: Inheritance
inheritance.body: Accepts HTMLAttributes<HTMLElement> (except color) and passes them to the root div (or to the child, with asChild). onClick, onPointerEnter, onPointerLeave, onFocus, and onBlur run before the effect's internal logic. The --gemfx-gradient-glossy-* variables of the props you pass are written after style; the ones you don't pass aren't written. While isPaused is on, the effect writes --gemfx-gradient-glossy-amount (at its current value) and transition: none inline, and restores whatever was there when unpaused. The base layout (display, position, color) and the transition live in :where(), so any host class overrides them.

items.reducedMotion: With prefers-reduced-motion: reduce the fade is removed: the gloss turns on and off without a transition.
items.ignoreReducedMotion: ignoreReducedMotion (or the gemfx-ignore-reduced-motion class on an ancestor) keeps the fade. Only use it when essential.
items.decorative: The gloss is the element's own background and shadow: it adds no nodes, isn't announced, and doesn't block clicks.
items.focus: With trigger="hover" the gloss also appears when the host or something inside gets keyboard focus (:focus-visible), and the events fire just like with the pointer. With click the root isn't focusable: the keyboard only turns it on when the click comes from a control inside (Enter or Space on a button).
items.contrast: Without asChild the text inherits the color; with asChild the host keeps its own. Check contrast against all three stops, especially with light colors like tertiary-400 or warning-500, and with variant="deep", where the bottom gets much darker.

items.root: Root. `isolation: isolate`, the gradient as `background-image`, and the sheen as an inset `box-shadow` (with a doubled class, to beat `.gem-button`). `inline-flex`, `position`, `color`, and the transition live in `:where()`.
items.variant: Active variant. Sets the `md` values and the slope of `lift`, `depth`, and `sheen`.
items.direction: Active direction. Sets `--gemfx-gradient-glossy-angle` and the sheen offset.
items.trigger: Active trigger. Sets `cursor: pointer`, the fade transition, and turns the gloss off (`amount: 0`) while it isn't engaged.
items.on: Added while the gloss is on with `click`.
items.paused: Added with `isPaused`. The effect does the freezing inline, so no rule uses it: it's a hook for your own styles.
items.inactive: Added with `isActive={false}` or `isDisabled`. Sets `--gemfx-gradient-glossy-amount: 0`: transparent background and no sheen.
items.surface: Wraps the child (`z-index: 1`). With `asChild`, the class goes on the child itself.

cssVariables.title: CSS variables
cssVariables.description: Only the variables of the props you pass are written inline (`color`, `lift`, `depth`, `sheen`, `mid`, `intensity`, `duration`, `delay`), plus `--gemfx-gradient-glossy-amount` while `isPaused` is on. Everything else, and those same ones when you don't pass the prop, can be overridden from a class.

items.lift: Percentage of white in the light stop. Set by `lift`; otherwise computed from `variant` and `intensity`.
items.depth: Percentage of black in the dark stop. Set by `depth`; otherwise computed from `variant` and `intensity`.
items.sheen: Opacity of the white edge sheen. Set by `sheen`; otherwise computed from `variant` and `intensity`.
items.mid: Position of the base color stop. Set by `mid`; default `48%`.
items.light: Light stop: `color-mix` of the base color with white by `lift`. Override it to tint the light.
items.dark: Dark stop: `color-mix` of the base color with black by `depth`. Override it to tint the shade.
items.angle: Gradient axis (`to bottom`, `to top`…). Set by `direction`.
items.sheenOffset: Offset of the inset sheen (`1px` toward the lit side). Set by `direction`.
items.curve: Each variant's curve: the value at `md` and how much it changes per point of intensity. `lift`, `depth`, and `sheen` are `md + (intensity - 55%) × k`, between `0%` and `90%`.
items.amount: How much of the gloss shows, from `0` to `1` (registered with `@property`). The off states set it to `0` and it's the only thing that transitions. With `isPaused` it's pinned inline at its current value.
items.duration: Fade when turning on and off. Set by `duration`; default `220ms`.

tokens.title: Tokens
tokens.description: Global variables GradientGlossy reads as defaults. You can redefine them on the root with a class.

items.white: White mixed into the light stop and the sheen (fallback `#ffffff`).
items.intensity: Values for `sm`, `md`, and `lg` (`35%`, `55%`, and `80%`). The default uses `md` and the prop writes `var(--gemfx-intensity-*)` for tokens, so redefining them changes the contrast.

content.title: Content
content.description: What the gloss holds and where the effect mounts.

appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.description: Strength, direction, color, and gradient stops.

timing.title: Timing
timing.description: Fade when turning on and off, in milliseconds.

state.title: Trigger and state
state.description: When it shows, how the fade freezes, and how it turns off.

items.asChild: Applies the gloss to the single child, without a wrapping `div`. Meant for gem-system's `Button`.
items.variant: `soft` is milder, `lit` the classic gloss, and `deep` darkens the bottom more.
items.direction: Light → base → dark axis. `to-bottom` puts the light on top.
items.color: Base color. Prefer a token; any CSS color works. Default `primary-500`.
items.lift: Percentage of white in the light stop (`0`–`90`). When omitted it comes from `variant` + `intensity` (`28` with `lit` and `md`).
items.depth: Percentage of black in the dark stop (`0`–`90`). Default from `variant` + `intensity` (`32` with `lit` and `md`).
items.sheen: Opacity of the edge sheen (`0`–`90`). Default from `variant` + `intensity` (`50` with `lit` and `md`).
items.mid: Position of the base color stop, as a percentage.
items.intensity: Overall contrast: `sm`, `md`, `lg`, or a number from `0` to `1`. Resolved in CSS; it only affects the `lift`, `depth`, and `sheen` you don't pass.
items.duration: Fade when turning on and off. Negative values become `0`.
items.trigger: `always` shows it all the time, `hover` when the pointer enters or something inside gets keyboard focus, and `click` toggles it on each click.
items.isActive: Shows the gloss. With `false` it turns off and `outGradientGlossy` gets `inactive`.
items.isPaused: Freezes the gloss fade at its current value, even if the state changes. When unpaused, the fade continues from there toward the current state.
items.isDisabled: Turns the gloss off; the child stays interactive. `outGradientGlossy` gets `disabled`.
items.ignoreReducedMotion: Keeps the fade even if the user prefers less motion. Only when essential.
items.onGradientGlossy: Fires when the gloss turns on: on mount with `always`, on pointer enter or keyboard focus with `hover`, or on click with `click`.
items.outGradientGlossy: Fires when it turns off: on pointer or focus leave, on the next click, when disabled, or on unmount.
items.style: Inline styles for the root. The variables of the props you pass are written after it.
items.ref: Ref to the root (the `div`, or the child with `asChild`).
